title: G6 transmitter deaths after 25 and 24 days
symptom: G6 transmitters are dying prematurely: the first after 25 days, the second after 24 days. xDrip stops receiving data, system status shows 'Scanning…', and the transmitter's Bluetooth device cannot be found by other devices.
fix: The user reports that the problem was resolved by buying a newer phone with Android 9, running the same xDrip version.
evidence_quote: No, the latest version hasnt solved the problem. I had to buy a newer phone with android9. Running fine since then, with the same xDrip version.
